clips.title: The story
paras: Dalar Dawnweaver sends Shadow Priest Allister a warning from Silverpine Forest. A pendant bound for the Kirin Tor in Ambermill reveals their plan to awaken a dormant ley energy node beneath the town, and the Forsaken at the Sepulcher prepare to answer.

Dalar Dawnweaver studies a rune-inscribed pendant from a Dalaran supply crate and recalls an old Kirin Tor survey. Ambermill was chosen for a reason: the quiet village sits atop a dormant ley energy node. Dalar realizes the wizards intend to tap it. Awakening such a nexus takes immense magical reserves, and the enchanted pendants the wizards wear are key to channeling and catalyzing its power.

The Forsaken cannot tolerate a fortified, power-fueled Kirin Tor outpost threatening the southern approaches to the Sepulcher and Tirisfal Glades. Whatever ritual the magi prepare, raw ley energy would give Dalaran an enormous strategic advantage in Lordaeron. Dalar urgently sends word to Shadow Priest Allister, asking him to devise a way to stall the wizards before their ritual is complete.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Of course! How could I have forgotten?

Ambermill was one of the sites earmarked by the Kirin Tor, noted because it houses a dormant ley energy node. The wizards must be planning to reactivate the node and use its energies for some greater purpose.
We cannot allow this to happen...
It will take a great amount of power to activate the area's ley energies, we can stall them by taking the pendants away from the wizards.
Relay this information to Allister, he will decide a course of action.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ill news you bring, friend. If Dalar is correct--and I've no reason to believe he isn't--we must move quickly.
I must confer with him on our plan of attack. But in the meanwhile we will have to delay their progress.
